methods.label: Solve the inequality and apply the restriction
methods.explanation: \(x^2>4\) gives \(x<-2\) or \(x>2\). With the additional restriction \(-4<x<4\), the only integer solutions are \(-3\) and 3, giving 2 in total.

methods.label: Check the seven possible integers
